description: Deploys the corporate network as a Wi-Fi profile to every Mac, so that a device connects automatically after enrolment and a user never needs to know or type the network password. Baseline assignment: none yet — waits for a prerequisite, see the phase reason. Source: Own baseline — Intune Wi-Fi profile (macOSWiFiConfiguration), WPA/WPA2-Personal. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.20 and A.8.21, NIS2 art. 21(2)(e)..
